categories.main_business_segments: Mingguan New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of new composite film materials for the new energy sector. Its main product lines include photovoltaic (solar) cell backsheet materials, photovoltaic encapsulation films, lithium battery aluminum-plastic films, and special protective films. The company focuses on providing integrated packaging solutions for solar cells and lithium batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies including functional polymer film technology, special adhesive development, material surface treatment, optical design, precision coating and lamination, and functional material dispersion. Manufacturing involves advanced polymer modification, multi-layer film composite processes, and dry heat lamination for aluminum-plastic films. It also applies plasma surface treatment and physical vapor deposition to enhance product performance and durability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large global photovoltaic module manufacturers and lithium battery producers, including strategic clients such as JA Solar, Hanwha, BYD, Tongwei, and others. The company serves the solar energy and lithium battery industries, with applications in N-type solar cells, high-efficiency photovoltaic modules, and soft-pack lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, energy storage, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Mingguan New Materials operates primarily in China with headquarters in Yichun, Jiangxi Province. It has established overseas production capacity in Vietnam to serve Southeast Asian, American, and Turkish photovoltaic module customers. The company’s sales are mainly concentrated in overseas markets, accounting for a significant portion of revenue, with growing presence in Asia, the Middle East, and South Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, specializing in the production of key packaging materials for photovoltaic modules and lithium batteries. It supplies essential composite films that protect and enhance the performance of solar cells and lithium battery cells, positioning itself as a critical materials supplier to downstream module and battery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in high-efficiency N-type solar cell encapsulation materials, development of new products such as heterojunction cell carrier films, high-power light conversion encapsulation films, and low-acid encapsulation films for TOPCon modules. The company emphasizes R&D investment, talent acquisition, and collaboration with academic institutions, supported by a national postdoctoral research station. It also focuses on cost reduction, production efficiency, and digital transformation through MES, PLM, and ERP systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of composite film products including solar cell backsheets, encapsulation films, and lithium battery aluminum-plastic films. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some distribution for aluminum-plastic films. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts typically fulfilled at a point in time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Mingguan New Materials is a leading player in the photovoltaic packaging materials industry in China, holding a top-tier market position especially in solar cell backsheets and encapsulation films. It faces intense competition due to industry overcapacity and price pressure. The company is recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise, with strong intellectual property and standard-setting roles in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 864 million, a 38% decline from the previous year, mainly due to technological shifts and market price competition in the photovoltaic sector. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 67 million. The company has substantial assets totaling nearly RMB 2.93 billion and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Mingguan New Materials emphasizes its role as a reliable partner providing high-quality, innovative composite films that enhance the efficiency and durability of photovoltaic modules and lithium batteries. Its products feature advanced material properties such as high moisture resistance, UV stability, and electrical insulation. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, comprehensive packaging solutions tailored for emerging N-type solar cells, and a strong commitment to green and sustainable materials.
